messages:
Jared (PM): Opening thread for a "multilingual validation runway" proposal. Motivation: models behave differently by locale (tokenization, latency, semantic drift). Idea: staged runway with locale-specific benches + tenant opt-in pinning per locale. Quick sketch and asks below. Feedback?
Miri (ML): +1. We need per-locale eval sets (en, es, fr, de, pt, ja, ko) and embedding parity checks. Suggested numeric gates by locale: p95 latency <= 140ms (en), 160ms (non-en with longer tokenization), eval F1 >= baseline - 2.0% (relative), embed cosine drift <= 3%. I'll own the bench sets.
Oren (Eng): Infra notes: enforce hardware tags for regional canaries, limit batch size, and add a per-locale autoscale floor. Also add an emergency "hold" runtime flag to instantly stop a locale rollout. Deploy-bot, can you create a template job? :pray:
Deploy-bot: Created job: job/multilang-runway-v1. Regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1. Alerts wired: latency_p95_exceed, embed_drift_alert, infra_incident. Dashboard: /dash/multilang/runway-v1.
Lena (CS): Customer asks: per-tenant locale pinning visible in Console, default pin TTL 90 days per locale, auto-renew=false, and a clear "smooth-unpin" flow that ramps down locale traffic over 21 days. Need migration playbook + customer comm template.
Hannah (Sales): I'll draft a one-liner AE blurb: "Locale pins (90d) available per tenant; extensions via contract." Will loop legal. Also recommend an FAQ bullet for performance differences by locale.
Jared (PM): Proposed runway stages (sketch): 48h shadow smoke -> 10d micro-canary (3% per locale) -> 21d graded canary (20% per locale). Gate to full catalog admission: all locale benches pass, infra stability (<=1 incident/runway), docs + AE blurb published, and ML+Eng+CS signoff. Any veto holds.
Miri (ML): Adding human spot-check per locale: 12 samples reviewed, fail if >2 problematic. Also check tokenization parity: mismatch >3% triggers fail. Will run baseline this week.
Oren (Eng): Draft runtime config (will put in infra repo):
```
runway: multilang-runway-v1
stages:
  - smoke_hours: 48
  - micro_canary_days: 10
    traffic_pct_per_locale: 3
  - graded_canary_days: 21
    traffic_pct_per_locale: 20
hardware_tags_per_region: {us-west-2: [g5.xlarge], eu-west-1: [g5.xlarge], ap-northeast-1: [g5.2xlarge]}
autoscale_floor: 2
hold_flag: runtime.multilang_hold=true
```
Miri (ML): Will run per-locale benches and publish results here. Also requesting a small QA pool of customers for JA/KO since those often show unexpected tokenization issues.
Lena (CS): I'll draft the migration playbook and Console copy. Also adding per-tenant telemetry to measure locale-pin adoption and a short customer-facing explainer about what unpin does to response stability. Draft by Mon.
Hannah (Sales): AE blurb to legal now. ETA Tue.
Jared (PM): Owners for final GO: PM (Jared) + ML (Miri) + Eng (Oren) + CS (Lena). Action items: Oren add infra job + dashboard; Miri run benches; Lena docs + telemetry; Hannah AE blurb/legal. Scheduling 30m review next Thu to decide admission. :thumbsup:
